coverage.reason: Archive members and their bytes are checked against the package source tree, including the attributed Unicode grapheme subset. This SBOM covers the Roc source bundle only.
roc deps package/main.roc reports only the root package. No direct or transitive external package dependencies.

Five private Unicode*.roc modules adapt the grapheme subset of roc-lang/unicode 4.3.1 (source archive SHA-256 119846d77be7e87cff22396219a8d060833c4ee2c3b7e54ba94dc2fb7a37d168). Each is inventoried by exact shipped bytes and carries upstream attribution. Unicode 17 data and conformance fixtures use Unicode-3.0; Roc implementation uses UPL-1.0. Private names and compiler compatibility are modified; segmentation rules and data are unchanged.
The compiler executable is identified as build-only. Its native dependencies and other CI tooling are outside the shipped source dependency closure; this is not an executable SBOM.
